policy: Records which bespoke renderer owns each traced detailed site and each suppressed/replaced OpenStreetMap outline. Renderer module names are source-verified against narromine.js buildNarromine(); owner attribution is best-effort from COORDINATION.md/WORK_CHECKPOINT.md. This register must NOT promote any building to 'Verified Against Reference': rendering.status stays 'Mapped'/'Modelled' and visuallyVerified stays 0.

royal-hotel.mechanism: Dedicated builder; generic DETAILED loop skips royal-hotel/dandaloo-86/dandaloo-88 via ROYAL_HOTEL_REPLACED_IDS.
uncertainty: Facade accuracy not visually reviewed against ground-level photography

narromine-hotel.mechanism: Dedicated builder; generic DETAILED loop skips NARROMINE_HOTEL_ID.
uncertainty: Verandah lacework is procedural; rear outbuildings use LiDAR/aerial footprints without Street View visibility

narromine-post-office.mechanism: Generic walls/parts plus dedicated L-shaped roof overlay and entrance/interior module.
uncertainty: Window/door/colour details estimated; facade not visually reviewed

dandaloo-76.mechanism: Custom passage/courtyard builder layered on the generic detailed shell.
uncertainty: Interior plan remains an identified gameplay approximation

dandaloo-82.mechanism: Generic shell with dedicated gable roof + edge-segmented colliders; interior from narromine-coles.js.
uncertainty: No permissioned measured floorplan; interior is interpretive

dandaloo-86.mechanism: Church at 86 Dandaloo St built by the Royal Hotel module (86 & 88 together).
uncertainty: Window bay spacing and brick buttresses estimated

dandaloo-88.mechanism: His and Hers Clip Joint built by the Royal Hotel module (86 & 88 together).
uncertainty: Shopfront glazing and fascia lettering estimated

st-marys-anglican.mechanism: Generic detailed shell plus dedicated entrance/interior module.
uncertainty: Facade accuracy not visually reviewed; owner attribution not recorded
